name: wzrdmail
description: Email for AI agents. Create @wzrd.tech inboxes, send and receive mail, manage threads and drafts, and automate email workflows through the hosted wzrdmail MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Give your coding agent its own @wzrd.tech email inboxes. Create addresses on the fly, send and receive messages, manage threads, prepare drafts for human approval, handle attachments, and automate email workflows, all through natural language.
defaultPrompt: Create a new project inbox and draft a welcome email.
Check my wzrdmail inbox for new messages and summarize unread threads.
Prepare a reply to the latest email in my inbox as a draft for review.
